description: Local income-tax coverage for the pay-run guard (Spec 25 (PAY-120)). 'engine' = the app computes it; 'unsupported' = pay runs are held for employees living (basis residence) or working (basis work) there. A state with no row has no local income tax the employer withholds. Employer-paid-only taxes are not listed. Maintained by the state/local payroll SME; sourceVerified=true means the SME read the source page; false means only a search excerpt was seen, and the page must be read before enforcement.

Local earned income tax and local services tax (Act 32) and Philadelphia wage tax. Residence too: every employer located in Pennsylvania withholds the Philadelphia resident wage tax, and a home-based employee's residence is an Act 32 worksite; the app does not know the employer's location, so a Pennsylvania resident is always held.
